list_events.name: List events (with IDs)
list_events.description: Returns the events of a calendar including uid, recurrence_id and rrule, needed for update_event / delete_event.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Length of the period instead of an end (default: 1 day).

update_event.name: Update event
update_event.description: Changes an event in Google Calendar. Only the given fields are changed.

uid.name: UID
uid.description: ID of the event or series (from list_events).

recurrence_id.name: Recurrence ID
recurrence_id.description: ID of a single occurrence of a series. Empty = whole event/series.

recurrence_range.name: Range
recurrence_range.description: THISANDFUTURE = this and all following occurrences; empty = only this occurrence.

rrule.name: Recurrence rule
rrule.description: RFC 5545 RRULE without 'RRULE:' prefix. Empty string removes the recurrence.

delete_event.name: Delete event
delete_event.description: Deletes an event, a single occurrence or a part of a series in Google Calendar.

uid.name: UID
uid.description: ID of the event or series (from list_events).

recurrence_id.name: Recurrence ID
recurrence_id.description: ID of a single occurrence. Empty = delete the whole event/series.

recurrence_range.name: Range
recurrence_range.description: THISANDFUTURE = this and all following occurrences; empty = only this occurrence.

sync_calendar.name: Mirror calendar (one-way)
sync_calendar.description: Copies the events of a source calendar one-way into a target Google calendar. The source is only read and never changed. In the target only events created by this action are created, updated or deleted – your own events there stay untouched. Changed options are applied to already mirrored events on the next run. Run it regularly with an automation to keep the mirror up to date.

source_entity_id.name: Source calendar
source_entity_id.description: The calendar the events are read from. Any calendar in Home Assistant can be used (Google, local calendar, CalDAV, …). The source is never modified.

target_entity_id.name: Target calendar
target_entity_id.description: The Google calendar of this integration that receives the copies. You need write access to it. It must be a different calendar than the source.

days_past.name: Days in the past
days_past.description: Number of days before today that are synchronized (0 = start today). Mirrored events older than this are left untouched. With 0 days in the past and 0 days in the future only today's events are synchronized.

days_future.name: Days in the future
days_future.description: Number of days after today that are synchronized (0 = end today). Events further in the future are mirrored on a later run as soon as they move into the period.

include_details.name: Copy description and location
include_details.description: On: description and location are copied. Off: only title and times are copied, description and location of the copies are emptied – also for events mirrored earlier.

include_all_day.name: Copy all-day events
include_all_day.description: On: all-day events are mirrored as well. Off: all-day events are skipped and copies created earlier are removed.

include_regex.name: Only titles matching
include_regex.description: Optional. Regular expression on the event title (case-insensitive, a match anywhere in the title is enough), e.g. 'Training|Jagd'. Only matching events are mirrored. If left empty, all events are synchronized. If 'Exclude titles matching' is also set, the exclusion has priority: an event matching both expressions is not synchronized.

exclude_regex.name: Exclude titles matching
exclude_regex.description: Optional. Regular expression on the event title (case-insensitive), e.g. 'privat|Arzt'. Matching events are not mirrored and existing copies are removed. If left empty, nothing is excluded. Has priority over 'Only titles matching': an event matching both expressions is not synchronized.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: On: nothing is written. The action only returns which events would be created, updated or deleted (shown as response). Useful to test the filters.
